page.content:
Elder gods whom Zeus overthrew and cast into Tartarus.

How Titans connects

  • Character: Zeus — Zeus overthrew the Titans and bound them below.
  • Location: Tartarus — Most Titans were imprisoned in Tartarus after the Titanomachy.
  • Character: Prometheus — Prometheus is a Titan who sided with mortals against Zeus.

What is Titans?

The Titans, children of Uranus and Gaia and led by Cronus, ruled before the Olympians. After the Titanomachy most were imprisoned in Tartarus; Prometheus and a few others take other paths.

Key threads lead to Zeus, Tartarus and Prometheus.
